title: How can we help?
intro: Most answers are in the FAQ. For anything else, email is the fastest way to reach us.

email.title: Email support
email.body: Questions about using the app? Write to us and we’ll get back to you.

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.body: Something not working? Opens an email with a short template to fill in.

feature.title: Request a feature
feature.body: Tell us what would make MacBook Cleaner more useful to you.

install.title: Installation help
install.body: Step-by-step install instructions and what to do about the first-launch security warning.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.body: Safety, privacy, permissions, compatibility and uninstalling — answered.

logsBody: For tricky problems we may ask for the app’s logs. They’re stored only on your Mac, in ~/Library/Logs/{{bundleId}}, and are never sent automatically. Logs can contain file paths from your Mac — look them over and remove anything you’d rather not share before attaching them.
